import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[11]; // since indexing starts at 1, size is 11 to accommodate up to 10
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            a[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        }
        List<Integer> vec = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            vec.add(a[i]);
        }
        Collections.sort(vec);
        int median_index = (n + 1) / 2 - 1; // zero-based index
        System.out.println(vec.get(median_index));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
